mapper.sql: AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM web_dsblty_excp_group_eqpmnt_rel M JOIN web_dsblty_excp_group_info G ON G.EXCP_GROUP_SN=M.EXCP_GROUP_SN AND G.USE_YN='Y' JOIN web_dsblty_excp_schdl_info X ON X.EXCP_GROUP_SN=G.EXCP_GROUP_SN AND X.USE_YN='Y' WHERE M.EMS_ID=D.ems_id AND M.DEVICE_ID=D.device_id AND NOW() >= X.BGNG_DT AND (X.NO_END_YN='Y' OR X.END_DT IS NULL OR NOW() <= X.END_DT) AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM web_dsblty_excp_schdl_grd_rel R WHERE R.EXCP_SCHDL_SN=X.EXCP_SCHDL_SN) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM web_dsblty_excp_schdl_grd_rel R WHERE R.EXCP_SCHDL_SN=X.EXCP_SCHDL_SN AND R.DSBLTY_GRD_CD=CASE D.event_grade WHEN '1' THEN 'EMERGENCY' WHEN '2' THEN 'HIGH' WHEN '3' THEN 'LOW' WHEN '4' THEN 'WARNING' WHEN '5' THEN 'INFO' END)) AND ( X.REPT_CYCLE_CN='ONCE' OR (X.REPT_CYCLE_CN LIKE 'REPEAT|%' AND (X.REPT_CYCLE_CN LIKE 'REPEAT|DAILY|%' OR (X.REPT_CYCLE_CN LIKE 'REPEAT|WEEKLY|%' AND FIND_IN_SET(ELT(WEEKDAY(NOW())+1,'MON','TUE','WED','THU','FRI','SAT','SUN'), SUBSTRING_INDEX(X.REPT_CYCLE_CN,'|',-1)) > 0) OR (X.REPT_CYCLE_CN LIKE 'REPEAT|MONTHLY|%' AND DAYOFMONTH(NOW())=DAYOFMONTH(X.BGNG_DT))) AND (X.REPT_START_TM IS NULL OR X.REPT_END_TM IS NULL OR (X.REPT_START_TM <= X.REPT_END_TM AND TIME(NOW()) BETWEEN X.REPT_START_TM AND X.REPT_END_TM) OR (X.REPT_START_TM > X.REPT_END_TM AND (TIME(NOW()) >= X.REPT_START_TM OR TIME(NOW()) <= X.REPT_END_TM))))) )

SELECT CONCAT('FAULT:GW-A-',D.event_seq) AS NOTIFICATION_ID, 'FAULT' AS CATEGORY_CD, '고장' AS CATEGORY_NM, CASE D.event_grade WHEN '1' THEN 'CRITICAL' WHEN '2' THEN 'CRITICAL' WHEN '3' THEN 'CAUTION' WHEN '4' THEN 'CAUTION' ELSE 'INFO' END AS SEVERITY_CD, CONCAT(COALESCE(S.STN_NM,D.event_loc,D.device_id), ' 장애 알림') AS TITLE, D.event_msg AS MESSAGE, CONCAT(COALESCE(L.LINK_SYS_NM,'TNMS'),' · ',COALESCE(E.device_nm,D.device_id)) AS SOURCE_NAME, CONCAT('GW-A-',D.event_seq) AS REF_KEY, D.event_dt AS EVENT_DT_RAW, '/fault/realtime.do?screen=faults' AS TARGET_URL FROM raw_event_action D LEFT JOIN com_device_info E ON E.ems_id=D.ems_id AND E.device_id=D.device_id LEFT JOIN com_stn_info S ON S.STN_CD=E.stn_cd LEFT JOIN web_link_sys_info L ON L.LINK_SYS_CD=((SELECT SM.link_sys_cd FROM vw_tnms_system_map SM WHERE SM.ems_id=D.ems_id)) WHERE D.event_yn=1 AND D.event_grade IN ('1','2','3','4','5')
AND D.event_dt >= DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND D.ems_id IN #{id} UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('FAULT:WEB-P-',D.PERF_EVENT_SN) AS NOTIFICATION_ID, 'FAULT' AS CATEGORY_CD,'고장' AS CATEGORY_NM, CASE WHEN D.EVENT_GRADE IN (1,2) THEN 'CRITICAL' WHEN D.EVENT_GRADE IN (3,4) THEN 'CAUTION' ELSE 'INFO' END AS SEVERITY_CD, CONCAT(COALESCE(S.STN_NM,D.DEVICE_ID),' 성능 임계치 장애') AS TITLE, CONCAT(CASE WHEN D.PERF_IDCT_CD='CPU_USGRT' THEN 'CPU' ELSE 'MEMORY' END,' 사용률 ',D.LAST_VALUE,'% 임계치 초과') AS MESSAGE, CONCAT(COALESCE(L.LINK_SYS_NM,'TNMS'),' · ',COALESCE(E.device_nm,D.DEVICE_ID)) AS SOURCE_NAME, CONCAT('WEB-P-',D.PERF_EVENT_SN) AS REF_KEY,D.EVENT_DT AS EVENT_DT_RAW, '/fault/realtime.do?screen=faults' AS TARGET_URL FROM web_perf_thrshld_event D LEFT JOIN com_device_info E ON E.ems_id=D.EMS_ID AND E.device_id=D.DEVICE_ID LEFT JOIN com_stn_info S ON S.STN_CD=E.stn_cd LEFT JOIN web_link_sys_info L ON L.LINK_SYS_CD=(SELECT SM.link_sys_cd FROM vw_tnms_system_map SM WHERE SM.ems_id=D.EMS_ID) WHERE D.EVENT_YN=1
AND D.EVENT_DT >= DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND D.EMS_ID IN #{id} UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('ACCOUNT:', A.APLY_NO) AS NOTIFICATION_ID, 'ACCOUNT' AS CATEGORY_CD, '계정신청' AS CATEGORY_NM, CASE WHEN A.APLY_STTS_CD = 'REJECTED' THEN 'CAUTION' ELSE 'NORMAL' END AS SEVERITY_CD, CASE A.APLY_STTS_CD WHEN 'WAITING' THEN '신규 계정 신청' WHEN 'APPROVED' THEN '계정 신청 승인 완료' WHEN 'REJECTED' THEN '계정 신청 반려' ELSE '계정 신청 상태 변경' END AS TITLE, CONCAT(A.USER_NM, ' (', A.USER_ID, ') · ', COALESCE(A.OGDP_BZENTY_NM, '-'), CASE WHEN A.DEPT_NM IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CONCAT(' / ', A.DEPT_NM) END) AS MESSAGE, COALESCE(A.OGDP_BZENTY_NM, '계정관리') AS SOURCE_NAME, A.APLY_NO AS REF_KEY, COALESCE(A.APRV_DT, A.APLY_DT) AS EVENT_DT_RAW, '/user/list.do?screen=users' AS TARGET_URL FROM web_user_acnt_aply_info A WHERE A.APLY_DT >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('OP:', J.JOB_LOG_SN) AS NOTIFICATION_ID, CASE WHEN J.CNTN_MENU_NM LIKE '%권한%' OR J.CNTN_MENU_NM LIKE '%공통코드%' OR J.CNTN_MENU_NM LIKE '%설정%' THEN 'SETTING' ELSE 'OPERATION' END AS CATEGORY_CD, CASE WHEN J.CNTN_MENU_NM LIKE '%권한%' OR J.CNTN_MENU_NM LIKE '%공통코드%' OR J.CNTN_MENU_NM LIKE '%설정%' THEN '설정' ELSE '운영관리' END AS CATEGORY_NM, CASE WHEN J.JOB_RSLT_CD = 'SUCCESS' THEN 'NORMAL' ELSE 'CRITICAL' END AS SEVERITY_CD, CASE WHEN J.JOB_RSLT_CD = 'SUCCESS' THEN CONCAT(COALESCE(J.CNTN_MENU_NM, '운영관리'), ' 작업 완료') ELSE CONCAT(COALESCE(J.CNTN_MENU_NM, '운영관리'), ' 작업 실패') END AS TITLE, COALESCE(J.LOG_CN, J.TRGT_KEY_VL, '작업 이력이 등록되었습니다.') AS MESSAGE, CONCAT(COALESCE(J.USER_ID, 'SYSTEM'), ' · ', COALESCE(J.USER_IP_ADDR, '-')) AS SOURCE_NAME, CAST(J.JOB_LOG_SN AS CHAR) AS REF_KEY, J.LOG_CRT_DT AS EVENT_DT_RAW, '/audit/job-log.do?screen=logs' AS TARGET_URL FROM web_job_log J WHERE J.LOG_CRT_DT >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND (J.JOB_RSLT_CD <> 'SUCCESS' OR J.CNTN_MENU_NM LIKE '%권한%' OR J.CNTN_MENU_NM LIKE '%계정%' OR J.CNTN_MENU_NM LIKE '%공통코드%' OR J.CNTN_MENU_NM LIKE '%설정%')

SELECT N.NOTIFICATION_ID, N.CATEGORY_CD, N.CATEGORY_NM, N.SEVERITY_CD, N.TITLE, N.MESSAGE, N.SOURCE_NAME, N.REF_KEY, DATE_FORMAT(N.EVENT_DT_RAW, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS EVENT_DT, N.TARGET_URL, CASE WHEN R.USER_ID IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS READ_YN, DATE_FORMAT(R.READ_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS READ_DT FROM (
) N LEFT JOIN web_user_ntcn_read_info R ON R.USER_ID = #{userId} AND R.NTCN_ID = N.NOTIFICATION_ID ORDER BY N.EVENT_DT_RAW DESC, N.NOTIFICATION_ID DESC LIMIT 60
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO web_user_ntcn_read_info (USER_ID, NTCN_ID, READ_DT) VALUES (#{userId}, #{notificationId}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE READ_DT = VALUES(READ_DT)
